== Notes ==
* In lieu of an [[icy]] [[weapon upgrade]], consider using a skill that changes your damage to cold like [[Grenth's Fingers]].
* The skill's [[Armor-ignoring damage|armor-ignoring]] damage is added on every hit, including  those from [[Attack#Skills dealing multiple attacks|skills dealing multiple attacks]], [[scythe attack]]s, and [[dual attack]]s.
